verdict.rationale: Notion has no documented changelog feature, but a changelog could be assembled from its building blocks: the GitHub sync integration, the REST API for creating pages and databases, webhooks, and Agents or Skills for repeatable workflows. All of this requires custom scripting or agent setup, and nothing ties it to per-release changelogs. Missing for 10: a native release-changelog generation feature, documented release or tag triggers from source control, any guide or hands-on example of generating changelogs.
